name: Tinkerer
info: Increase IP by 2. You may initiate Projects.

data.name: Emergency Item
data.description: Once per conflict scene, if you are in `Crisis`, you may perform an additional action on your turn. This action `must` be the `Inventory` action.

data.name: Gadgets
data.description:
When you first acquire this Skill, choose a gadget type: `alchemy`, `infusions`, `magitech armaments`, or `magispheres`. You gain its `basic benefits`.
 Whenever you take this Skill again, choose one option: you gain the `basic benefits` of a new gadget type; `or` you gain the `advanced benefits` of a gadget type whose `basic benefits` you already obtained; `or` you gain the `superior benefits` of a gadget type whose `advanced benefits` you already obtained.

data.name: Potion Rain
data.description: When you create a `potion` that restores a `single` creature's HP and/or MP, you may have it affect up to`【SL】`additional creatures. If you do, the potion only restores half the normal amount of HP and MP to each creature.

data.name: Secret Formula
data.description:
When you create a `potion` or `magisphere` whose effects restore HP and/or MP, each restored amount is increased by`【SL × 5】`.
When you create an `elemental shard`, `potion` or `magisphere` that deals damage, that item deals`【SL】`extra damage.

data.name: Visionary
data.description:
When you work on a `Project`, up to`【SL × 100】`zenit of material costs are automatically paid; additionally, you generate an additional`【SL】progress` every day. If multiple characters with this Skill work on the same Project, the effects will be cumulative.

*If your group uses the optional rule for `Cinematic Projects`:* when you or another Player Character create a `quick Project`, its cost in materials is reduced by`【SL × 100】`zenit. When your group works on a `slow Project`, the invention's maximum cost is increased by`【SL × 200】`zenit, and`【SL × 100】`zenit of its material costs are automatically paid.

data.name: Gadgets - Alchemy
data.description:
You may perform the `Inventory` action to rapidly craft a `potion` with powerful but somewhat unpredictable effects. When you do so, choose one type of `mix` among those you have unlocked (`basic`, `advanced` or `superior`) and spend the appropriate amount of Inventory Points.

When you create a mix, roll the amount of twenty-sided dice indicated by that mix, then assign one of those rolls to the `target` table and one to the `effect` table. Discard all remaining dice, then describe the effects of the mix!

The two effects marked with '`Any`' on the `effect` table are always available and can be chosen if none of the available effects appeal to you.

data.name: Mix
table: Roll two `d20`s and assign one to `target` and one to `effect`.
Roll three `d20`s and assign one to `target` and one to `effect`.
Roll four `d20`s and assign one to `target` and one to `effect`.

data.name: Target
table: ... you `or` one ally you can see that is present on the scene.
... one enemy you can see that is present on the scene.
... you `and` every ally present on the scene.
... every enemy present on the scene.

data.name: Effect
table: Each creature affected by the potion...
... is dealt 20 `poison` damage. This amount increases to 30 damage if you are `level 20 or higher`, or to 40 damage if you are `level 40 or higher`.
... recovers 30 Hit Points and 30 Mind Points.
... treats their `Dexterity` and `Might` dice as if they were one size higher (up to a maximum of `d12`) until the end of your next turn.
... is dealt 20 `air` damage. This amount increases to 30 damage if you are `level 20 or higher`, or to 40 damage if you are `level 40 or higher`.
... gains Resistance to `air` and `fire` damage until the end of the scene.
As effect `9`, but with `bolt` and `ice` damage.
As effect 9, but with `dark` and `earth` damage.
... recovers 50 Hit Points and 50 Mind Points.
... recovers 100 Hit Points and 100 Mind Points.

data.name: Gadgets - Infusions
data.description:
When you successfully hit one or more targets with an attack, you may spend 2 Inventory Points to produce a special `infusion` and apply the corresponding effect to that attack (if the attack had the `multi` property, apply the effects of the infusion to each target).

`You cannot apply more than one infusion to the same attack; producing and using an infusion are both part of the action you used to attack with the weapon`.

data.name: Cryo
data.description: The attack deals 5 extra damage, and its damage becomes `ice`.

data.name: Pyro
data.description: The attack deals 5 extra damage, and its damage becomes `fire`.

data.name: Volt
data.description: The attack deals 5 extra damage, and its damage becomes `bolt`.

data.name: Cyclone
data.description: The attack deals 5 extra damage, and its damage becomes `air`.

data.name: Exorcism
data.description: The attack deals 5 extra damage, and its damage becomes `light`.

data.name: Seismic
data.description: The attack deals 5 extra damage, and its damage becomes `earth`.

data.name: Shadow
data.description: The attack deals 5 extra damage, and its damage becomes `dark`.

data.name: Vampire
data.description:
Choose one option: you recover an amount of HP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack; `or` you recover an amount of MP equal to half the HP loss suffered by the target of the attack. 
This infusion can only be used if the attack targeted `a single` creature.

data.name: Venom
data.description: The attack deals 5 extra damage, its damage becomes `poison`, and each creature hit by the attack suffers `poisoned`.

data.name: Gadgets - Magitech
data.description:
Also: Engineering, Golemcraft, Robotics.

This invention type grants a variety of different benefits.

data.name: Magitech Override
data.description: During a conflict, you may use an action and spend 10 Mind Points to choose a `construct` or `elemental` enemy you can see that does not possess independent intelligence and is suffering from `one or more status effects`. If you do so, that enemy recovers from all status effects, then the Game Master reveals its `entire profile` and you may force it to immediately perform an action of your choice; during that action, the creature is treated as an ally of your group.

data.name: Magicannon
data.description:
You may perform the `Inventory` action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a `magicannon` (see below) and destroy any `magicannon` you previously created. If you do so and both your `hand slots` are empty, you may immediately equip the newly created magicannon and perform a `free attack` with it. Whenever you create a `magicannon`, choose what type of damage it deals among `air`, `bolt`, `earth`, `fire`, `ice`, or `physical`.

*Magicannon*
Accuracy:`【DEX + INS】+1`
Damage:`【HR + 10】`
Properties: Firearm • Two-handed • Ranged • Cannot have Qualities.

data.name: Magispheres
data.description:
You develop a `magisphere` for each of `three spells` from among those found in the `Elementalist`, `Entropist`, and `Spiritist` lists; these spells may come from the same list or from different lists (this `does not` count as 'learning' or 'knowing' these spells).

You develop a new `magisphere` upon reaching `level 20`, and another upon reaching `level 40` (the same applies if you already reached those levels).

You may perform the `Inventory` action and spend 2 Inventory Points to perform the `Spell` action for free, casting one of the spells you have developed a `magisphere` for. The spell follows the normal rules (including MP costs and Magic Checks).

data.name: Gadgets - Magispheres
data.description: This invention type grants a variety of spells that can be casted with IP points.

data.name: Basic Magispheres
data.description:
Choose `two different spells` with a `target` of 'Up to three creatures' from among those found in the `Elementalist`, `Entropist`, and `Spiritist` lists; these two spells may come from the same list or from different lists (for instance, you could select `Lux` from `Spiritist` and `Elemental Shroud` from `Elementalist`). You develop a `magisphere` for each of these spells (this `does not` count as 'learning' or 'knowing' these spells).
You may perform the `Inventory` action and spend 2 Inventory Points to immediately perform the `Spell` action for free, casting one of the spells you have developed a `magisphere` for. The spell follows the normal rules (including MP costs and Magic Checks), and the Magic Check for spells cast through `magispheres` is`【INS + WLP】`.

data.name: Advanced Magispheres
data.description:
Choose `two different spells` from the list of `NPC spells` (see page 310); you may not choose the `Devastation` spell. You develop a `magisphere` for each spell chosen this way (this `does not` count as 'learning' or 'knowing' these spells), and must customize the chosen spells as required (for instance, if you select `Cursed Breath` for a `magisphere`, you could choose `ice` and `slow` and rename it freezing grenade).

You also gain a +2 bonus to your Magic Checks for offensive spells (*ϟ*) you cast through your `magispheres`.

data.name: Superior Magispheres
data.description: Choose `two different spells` from among those found in the `Elementalist`, `Entropist`, and `Spiritist` lists, and/or the list of `NPC spells`; these two spells may come from the same list or from different lists (for instance, you could select `Acceleration` from `Entropist` and `Area Status` from the list of `NPC spells`). You may not choose the `Devastation` spell. You develop a `magisphere` for each spell chosen this way (this `does not` count as 'learning' or 'knowing' these spells), and must customize any `NPC spells` chosen this way as required.

data.name: Gadgets - Magitech Armament
data.description:
*Branching Magitech: if you play with magitech armament, you cannot acquire the `Quantum Magicannon` Heroic Skill.*

This invention type allows you to create powerful customizable weapons that combine magic and technology.

data.name: Basic Armament
data.description:
You may perform the `Inventory` action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a `magitech armament` (see below) and destroy any magitech armament you previously created. Whenever you create a magitech armament, choose a Category for it, choose whether it is a `melee` or `ranged` weapon, and choose an Accuracy formula between`【DEX + INS】+1` and`【INS + MIG】+1` for it. Magitech armaments are always two-handed weapons.

*Magitech Armament*
Accuracy: (as chosen above)
Damage:`【HR + 12】`physical
Properties: One Category of your choice among `arcane`, `bow`, `brawling`, `dagger`, `firearm`, `flail`, `heavy`, `spear`, `sword`, and `thrown` • Two-handed • Melee or Ranged • Cannot have Qualities (but see `Superior Armament`, below).

data.name: Advanced Armament
data.description:
When you create a `magitech armament` using the `Basic Armament` benefit above, if both your `hand slots` are empty, you may immediately equip that magitech armament and perform a `free attack` with it.

Additionally, whenever you create a magitech armament, you may choose `air`, `bolt`, `earth`, `fire`, or `ice`. If you do, the armament you create deals damage of that type instead of `physical`.

data.name: Superior Armament
data.description:
While you have your `magitech armament` equipped, you may use an action to choose one weapon in your `backpack` and `sublimate` it. When you do so, the chosen weapon disappears, and the previous weapon you sublimated (if any) reappears inside your backpack.

Every `magitech armament` you create has the same Quality as the last weapon you sublimated.
